title: Diagnosing Capability Preservation and Task Sensitivity in Memory Augmented Document Classifiers
abstract: arXiv:2512.06582v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: End task accuracy alone cannot determine whether a memory mechanism preserves an acquired capability, exposes sample-specific stored information, or contributes measurably to downstream performance. This study introduces Protected QL Memory and evaluates capability preservation, diagnostic access, and task performance sensitivity as distinct empirical properties. Protected QL Memory is a dual path document classifier combining a causal local pathway, an associative matrix writer, and a finalized memory reader. A capability-protected schedule acquires a controlled binding capability, adapts the local pathway while constraining writer degradation, trains controlled memory access, and restricts full path task fitting. Pre and post adaptation diagnostics and finalized-memory interventions were evaluated across nine dataset-seed conditions. Writer capability was fully preserved, with 100% post-adaptation accuracy. translated_title: 诊断记忆增强文档分类器中的能力保持与任务敏感性
translated_abstract: 仅凭最终任务准确性无法确定记忆机制是否保持了已获取的能力、是否暴露了样本特定的存储信息，或是否对下游性能有可测量的贡献。本研究引入了受保护的QL记忆，并将能力保持、诊断访问和任务性能敏感性作为独立的经验属性进行评估。受保护的QL记忆是一种双路径文档分类器，结合了因果局部路径、关联矩阵写入器和最终记忆读取器。一种能力保护调度获取受控的绑定能力，在约束写入器退化的同时适应局部路径，训练受控的记忆访问，并限制全路径任务拟合。在九个数据集-种子条件下评估了适应前后的诊断和最终记忆干预。写入器能力完全保持，适应后准确率为100%。循环重新分配...
tldr: 本文提出了一种受保护的QL记忆机制，通过双路径架构和专用训练调度，在文档分类中实现了写入器能力的完全保持，同时诊断性证明了记忆访问与任务性能的独立可测性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Protected QL Memory, a dual-path document classifier with a capability-preserving training schedule, achieving 100% post-adaptation writer accuracy and empirically separating capability preservation, diagnostic access, and task sensitivity.
